pick.headline: Earthquake strikes central Chile
pick.summary: On the evening of March 3, 1985, a major earthquake struck central Chile, centered off the coast near Valparaíso and San Antonio, killing well over a hundred people and damaging Santiago and the port cities.
pick.significance: The earthquake struck a country under Pinochet's military government, which used emergency powers in its aftermath; it was among the strongest to hit central Chile in the twentieth century.
